title: discord Command Logger
description: This is a simple plugin that allows you to connect a discord channel to your Minecraft server and have it display all commands being used and by who.
body:
This is a plugin for paper minecraft server to enchance moderation for those on discord! 

- Just go into the config.yml file in the /plugins/CommandLogger/ folder and add your discord bot token and channel Id for the channel you want to add the logs! 

After that it will Always log commands used by anyone and who used them in your discord server! 

This is very efficient and helpful for server mods to see what people are doing!

Currently being used for: ThinkSMP ( IP: play.thinksmpnetwork.com)
